result.title: STC-MGNet: Spatial-Temporal-Channel Attention-Enhanced Multimodal Graph Network for Pedestrian Intention Prediction
result.summary: Accurate prediction of pedestrian crossing intentions plays a critical role in enhancing the safety of pedestrian-vehicle interactions in autonomous driving. However, effectively capturing subtle spatiotemporal patterns in pedestrian pose sequences and integrating complementary visual and ego-vehicle motion information remain challenging. This paper proposes a spatial-temporal-channel attention-enhanced multimodal graph network (STC-MGNet) for pedestrian crossing intention prediction. STC-MGNet introduces a spatial-temporal-channel (STC) attention-enhanced pose graph encoder to learn discriminative representations from pedestrian pose sequences. Three parallel attention branches selectively emphasize informative skeletal joints, observation frames, and feature channels, with their outputs integrated through learnable fusion weights. To leverage complementary visual and ego-vehicle motion information, a multi-stage cross-modal channel modulation mechanism is introduced to adaptively refine pose representations through modality-specific channel gating at successive graph encoding stages. Experimental results demonstrate that STC-MGNet achieves accuracy rates of 70%, 87%, and 88% on the JAADbeh, JAADall, and PIE datasets, respectively, outperforming several representative baseline methods. Ablation experiments further highlight the complementary contributions of visual and ego-vehicle motion information to prediction performance.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 STC-MGNet，用时空通道注意力增强的姿态图编码器学习行人姿态序列表示，并以多阶段跨模态通道调制机制融合视觉与自车运动信息，预测行人过街意图，在 JAAD 与 PIE 上验证效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「多阶段跨模态通道调制」逐编码阶段用模态特定门控修正姿态表示，可作为视觉证据如何注入并更新内部状态的线索，供核查通道门控是保留还是压缩视觉细节；但任务是意图预测，与 LVR 推理状态生成无直接关系。
